lines.text: On the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue in Capernaum and taught, and the people were astonished at His authority.
A man with an unclean spirit called Jesus the Son of David, and Jesus told the spirit to be silent and come out.
The news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
At the home of Simon and Andrew, Jesus took the hand of Simon's mother-in-law, and the fever left her.
Early in the morning Jesus went to a solitary place to pray, and when Simon found Him He said to go on to Jerusalem.
